picks.headline: Meshy Details Mora, a Research Architecture for AI-Generated Interactive Worlds, and Launches Meshy 7.1
picks.excerpt: Meshy details Mora, an architecture combining coding agents (game logic), 3D generation (assets/space) and a real-time video model (final imagery) for playable AI worlds, and ships Meshy 7.1 with Ultra 4K 4096^3 voxel geometry. Off-list: no allowed outlet covered it.
picks.rationale: Shipping 3D-generation release (Meshy 7.1) plus a concrete agent+3D+video architecture for playable worlds; most actionable tool news in the pool, primary source.

picks.headline: PixVerse Introduces R2, Advancing Its Real-Time World Model Toward Persistent, Playable Worlds
picks.excerpt: PixVerse R2 upgrades its real-time world model toward persistent, playable worlds: longer coherent sessions, memory that carries actions forward, and text/audio/action inputs driving synchronized video and audio. Off-list: no allowed outlet covered it.
picks.rationale: New real-time world model release with action memory and multimodal input; novel interactive-generation step, not previously covered in games.

picks.headline: New $500 AI-Powered Console Can Create Digital Tabletop Games From Scratch
picks.excerpt: EverBoard's $500 AI-powered tabletop console uses 'EverVibe' to generate digital board games from scratch; the company explains how it works and what ongoing access will cost.
picks.rationale: Consumer hardware that generates playable board games via AI, with pricing and access model explained; novel product from a reputable outlet.

picks.headline: UK's Largest Tabletop Convention Bans AI
picks.excerpt: As AI generated material consumes much of the gaming and entertainment world, major tabletop players like UKGE refuse to roll the dice with the unpopular tech
picks.rationale: Freshest item in the pool; a major event's AI ban with exceptions directly changes what creators and exhibitors can bring.

picks.headline: "The Robloxification of Steam": Creator of viral game apologizes after slop rip-offs flood Valve's store
picks.excerpt: The creator of viral hit Needle In A Haystack Simulator apologizes as clones - many evidently relying on generative AI - flood Steam, dubbed 'the Robloxification of Steam'.
picks.rationale: Distinct event from the 9-22 potato-peeler clone card: a wave of genAI clones swamping Steam around one viral hit, showing platform-level impact on indie discoverability.
